messages:
release-mgr: starting canary deploy for redwood/api:1.3.0 in the us-east change window, wave=1 (10%). tagging as deploy-1782504321-canary

deploy-bot: preflight checks complete for deploy-1782504321
SBOM scan: OK (licenses)
Vulnerability scan: 4 findings
  - CVE-2026-0456 (libbar) - CRITICAL - introduced via buildpack layer
  - CVE-2026-0123 (package-foo) - MEDIUM
  - CVE-2026-0789 (trans-dep) - MEDIUM
  - CVE-2025-9999 (optional-lib) - MEDIUM
Policy: block_critical=true, max_medium=2
Status: BLOCKED (1 critical, 3 medium) :warning:

alice.dev: uh, I thought 1.3.0 had only medium findings. where's the critical coming from?

deploy-bot: trace: critical originates from buildpack 'python-buildpack v2.3.1' -> layer libbar v2.0.6
SBOM link: https://artifacts.internal/sbom/redwood-api/1.3.0

maria.security: :eyes: we cannot push a critical CVE to prod. Policy is explicit: criticals block automatic rollouts.

sam.sre: short-term mitigation question: do we have an RCE exploit vector? If it's just a library bug without exploitable path in our app, we could consider a compensated rollout + monitoring, but that's risky.

release-mgr: options on the table:
  A) abort rollout and pin back to stable 1.2.5
  B) rebuild image with libbar upgrade (1.3.1) and re-run scans
  C) proceed with canary and request security exception (requires written risk doc and 2 approvers)

maria.security: my recommendation: block and rebuild (B). If rebuild not ready within the window, do not proceed.

alice.dev: building patched image now -> redwood/api:1.3.1 with libbar@1.3.1. running local SBOM + vuln scan (quick run).

deploy-bot: new scan results for redwood/api:1.3.1:
  - CVE-2026-0456 (libbar) - REMEDIATED
  - Remaining: CVE-2026-0123, CVE-2026-0789 -> 2 medium (within policy)
Status: PASS :white_check_mark:

release-mgr: excellent. alice, push artifact and regenerate release notes. sam, can you kick off canary for the patched image?

sam.sre: canary starting now -> wave=1, hosts=3, id=deploy-1782504321-canary-1. monitoring: cpu, latency, 5xx, and error traces for libbar-related calls. auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx>1% or median latency +50ms. will watch 15m.

ops-oncall: enabling canary feature flag and alerting. if anything spikes I'll roll back to 1.2.5 manually if auto-rollback doesn't trigger. :triangular_flag_on_post:

deploy-bot: canary started (deploy-1782504321-canary-1). status=IN_PROGRESS. healthchecks scheduled every 30s.

maria.security: I will approve progression to wave 2 after 30m stable canary. Please attach the SBOM diff and updated artifact hash to the release notes.

release-mgr: copied. adding note: 'security: upgraded libbar to remediate CVE-2026-0456; SBOM regenerated; vuln scan passed policy.'

alice.dev: pushed release notes snippet and artifact metadata: sha256:3a7b...f9c. link: https://artifacts.internal/releases/1782504321

sam.sre: canary stable at +20m, no errors, latency in expected range. advancing to wave 2 (30% total).

deploy-bot: wave 2 complete. monitoring summary: 5m buckets show healthy; 5xx=0.2%, median latency +8ms.

maria.security: approving full rollout based on canary. approval: maria.security :white_check_mark:

release-mgr: rolling out to remaining waves. documenting final decision: rebuild to 1.3.1, blocked earlier due to critical, patched and re-scanned, canary validated.

alice.dev: final release notes: 'redwood/api v1.3.1: security fixes (CVE-2026-0456), SBOM updated, vuln policy checks passed. See artifact sha256:3a7b...f9c and SBOM diff.'

deploy-bot: deployment finished: status=SUCCESS. rollout=100%. closing thread.

ops-oncall: leaving a follow-up ticket to add buildpack pinning to CI to avoid transitive surprises: TICKET-4217.

release-mgr: thanks team. great coordination. :tada:
